question: Which of the following is a web browser created and developed by Microsoft?
solution:
The correct answer is __Microsoft Edge.__

 
• Microsoft's new Windows 10 web browser will be called 'Microsoft Edge'.
 
• Microsoft Edge is a cross-platform web browser developed by Microsoft.
